liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer specifically recommends checking out the performance of China Cat Sunflower; The transition from China Cat to I Know You Rider is called amazing [16][21]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Black Throated Wind is described as full of energy [21]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Reviewer usually dislikes Donna but loves her performance on this specific track [10]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The transition from Dark Star into El Paso is described as fantastic [10]
- **El Paso** (1 review): El Paso and Deal are highlighted for their interesting transitions [18]

## The recordings

- **gd72-08-21.sbd.hamilton.150.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 184 min; rated 4.67/5 by 52 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer states the recording exemplifies what a recording is supposed to sound like; Reviewer describes the recording quality as stunning and the performance as intense; Reviewer notes the recording has a nice listenable tone [11][15][16][17]
- **gd1972-08-21.171736.mtx.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 175 min [4]
- **gd1972-08-21.139581.sbd.miller.sirmick.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1972-08-21.139581.sbd.miller.sirmick.fixed.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Phil and Billy resisted Jerry's attempt to transition into Morning Dew [12]
- Phil shut down Jerry's attempt to play Morning Dew after Dark Star [15]
- Reviewer thinks this show is overshadowed by the August 27th performance [10]
- Reviewer previously ranked this show highly until hearing the August 24th performance [12]
- Friend of the Devil and Mississippi Half Step echo the upcoming September shows [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-08-21.sbd.hamilton.150.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Signal chain: MR to PCM, DAT, CD, EAC, SHN via Hollister and Hamilton [1]
- **gd1972-08-21.171736.mtx.tobin.flac1648**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (48/16) [4]. Also: Mixed by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC in June 2025 [4]
- **gd1972-08-21.139581.sbd.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor-Jackson; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: SBD > Master Reels @ 7.5ips (10 Inch half-track ) > PCM > DAT (44.1k) - Recorded by Betty Cantor-Jackson, provided by Charlie Miller; Transfer: Dat >… [2]
- **gd1972-08-21.139581.sbd.miller.sirmick.fixed.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: SBD > Master Reels @ 7.5ips (10 Inch half-track ) > PCM > DAT (44.1k) - Recorded by Betty Cantor-Jackson, provided by Charlie Miller; Transfer: Dat >… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, Berkeley Community Theatre, Berkeley, CA. August 1972, three shows. (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/10/grateful-dead-berkeley-community.html) [26]
- Fan art by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, Berkeley Community Theatre, Berkeley, CA. August 1972, three shows. (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/10/grateful-dead-berkeley-community.html) [27]
